name: feed-curator-for-reddit
description: Firefox extension that filters unwanted posts out of Reddit feeds by category, subreddit, pattern and keyword. Entirely local.

scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename feed-curator-for-reddit-{version}.xpi --overwrite-dest
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run lint:ext
